caseName: National Dairy Products Corp. v. United States
caseNameFull: National Dairy Products Corp. v. United States
attorneys: John T. Chadwell, Richard W. McLaren and Martin J. Purcell for petitioner., Solicitor General Marshall, Assistant Attorney General Turner, Howard E. Shapiro and Raymond P. Hemacki for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded for further consideration in light of Dennis v. United States, ante, p. 855.
